info.name: Nembus - ZATCA Sales Order Test
info.description: ZATCA source is sales_orders_v2 + sales_order_lines_v2. Set an existing complete order UUID and the simulation device configuration. No new status, OTP or transaction creation is required. Generate signs once; submit reports that saved XML. Restaurant-specific checkout is excluded. First enable the organization through PUT /api/organizations/{id}/zatca with {"enabled":true}. ZATCA_ENABLED in the environment file no longer controls this feature.

exec: pm.test('Simulation enabled', function () { const d=pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.enabled).to.eql(true); pm.expect(d.environment_source).to.eql('device_config'); });

item.name: 3 - Generate or reuse signed ORDER invoice

request.description: No body. Uses the persisted order and all lines. New entity ID is the order UUID. Linked historical POS invoices are reused without issuing again.

exec: pm.test('Order document ready', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const d=pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.entity_type).to.be.oneOf(['sales_order_v2','pos_transaction']); pm.collectionVariables.set('zatca_uuid',d.zatca_uuid); pm.collectionVariables.set('zatca_hash',d.xml_hash); });

request.description: No body. Uses saved reporting CSID/secret. Already-reported documents return success without a new gateway call.

exec: pm.test('ZATCA reported the invoice', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const d=pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.zatca_response.reportingStatus).to.eql('REPORTED'); pm.expect(d.zatca_response.validationResults.errorMessages).to.have.lengthOf(0); if (pm.collectionVariables.get('zatca_uuid')) { pm.expect(d.zatca_uuid).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('zatca_uuid')); pm.expect(d.xml_hash).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('zatca_hash')); } });

item.name: 5 - Read saved receipt QR by order

request.description: No body. Calls compliance/invoices with compliance credentials. On fully onboarded devices ZATCA may return Submitted before; use the reporting request to test a normal sale.
